instruction: HOVER ON EACH STEP TO LEARN MORE

overviewNodes.tooltipDescription: A core responsibility of the Service Integrator will be receiving applications from User Support Services and validating applications before allowing User Support Services to grant them access to the Marketplace

nodes.label: REQUIREMENT
nodes.tooltipDescription: T&E Users include Ministry of Defence (MOD) personnel from Front Line Commands, Defence Agencies, Defence Organisations, and approved defence contractors who have passed the required assurance checks by the Marketplace.

nodes.label: User Support Services
nodes.tooltipDescription: Helps users understand T&E and find and engage the best services for their needs, and MOD to understand market health.

steps.tooltipDescription: Provides T&E users and suppliers with a single integrated portal to access the market.

nodes.label: T&E SERVICES
nodes.tooltipDescription: A combination of STEP-Funded T&E Services (Critical MOD owned or retained T&E capabilities, assets and services) and Other T&E Services (UK and international network of services, facilities and ranges available for T&E)

steps.tooltipDescription: Provide the in-service framework, available to the marketplace, for access to HPC in defence T&E
Provide a range of System of System Federations to de-risk introducing new capabilities into existing force structures
Provides access to T&E data at the speed of relevance by providing high quality communications, data repositories and configuration standards.
Delivers efficiency in conduct of deployed T&E by providing common deployable T&E assets (e.g. Targetry, instrumentation) when demand is sufficient

subSteps.tooltipDescription: Integration Services monitor gaps in enabling services. When demand exceeds capacity or becomes urgent, the issue is escalated to Innovation Services for resolution.

nodes.label: Innovation Services
nodes.tooltipDescription: Accelerates and optimises UK T&E R&D investment and de-risks STEP investment

nodes.label: Provider Proposals
nodes.description: Provider proposals offered to T&E Demand
